\section{Boundary-Reach Propagation}
\label{sec:boundary-propagation}

The second mechanism converts a backward boundary reach and a radial reach
into an upper bound for the forward reach of the same V triangle. Coverage of
the next edge then produces a lower bound for the next backward reach.  This
section records the common equilateral-enclosure calculus, center-assisted
path budget, exceptional T3-like and Vd placements, and the branchwise
propagation statements.  Formalization-only registries remain repository
verification objects and are not printed here.
